endorsements.name: Kris Wall
endorsements.label: Digital Forensics: Reconstructing an Attack in Modern Web Apps
endorsements.description: With modern application development moving at a feverish pitch, application security is struggling to catch up. Attacks against applications continues to grow in the wild west of new and untested development ideas. Web3? DevOps? Pipeline? Supply chain? With so many buzz words and an untold number of zero days yet to find, where does digital forensics fit? Where does your incident response team even start after an incident? Join us as we discuss the wild and wacky world of digital forensics in the modern era of application development and develop strategies to prepare your application security team for a breach.
